{{Otheruses|pathfinder}}
A '''Jedi pathfinder''' was a position within the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Exceptionally skilled at unraveling the secrets of uncharted worlds, these individuals combined their [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity]] with rigorous training to navigate and survey even the most treacherous environments with absolute precision. Often originating from primitive [[Planet/Legends|planets]] where survival demanded early mastery over nature, pathfinders frequently grew up exploring untamed wildlands, safeguarding their communities, and maintaining vital paths through the wilderness.<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Equipped with minimal supplies, they could endure hostile ecosystems for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] at a time, frequently forging deep, empathetic bonds with animal companions through the Force. By sharing senses, communicating [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]], and guiding the beasts' actions, many pathfinders found solace in the straightforward sincerity of wild creatures, preferring the quiet companionship of beasts to the complexities of sentient society.<ref name="FaDCR" />
